entities.name: Huang Tu-Shui
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Huang Tu-shui was a pioneer of modern sculpture in Taiwan. From his youth, Huang was familiar with the traditional carving of Taiwan, and was influenced by modern Western styles during his studies in Tokyo.
